response.sql: WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0 GROUP BY driverId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins FROM per_driver) SELECT p.driverId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.mean_avg_wins AS wins_difference FROM per_driver AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wins_difference IS NULL, wins_difference DESC LIMIT 10
